title: Shader Forge: Material Transmutation Lab
description: A mystical material laboratory where an iridescence lamp illuminates an avocado resting on a carbon fibre pedestal. The user manipulates custom shader parameters to transmute the avocado's surface through stages — from organic to metallic to holographic — by adjusting fresnel intensity, chromatic dispersion, noise distortion, iridescence blending, and carbon fibre weave overlay, with each parameter validated against target ranges to complete the transmutation ritual.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load three GLB assets: IridescenceLamp.glb positioned at (0, 1.5, -1) as the light source, Avocado.glb centered at (0, 0.3, 0) as the main subject scaled 30x, and CarbonFibre.glb placed at (0, -0.2, 0) scaled to act as a pedestal platform. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at (2, 2, 3) looking at origin with OrbitControls. Add ambient light (0.3 intensity) and a point light (warm color, intensity 2) parented to the lamp model's position. Create a custom ShaderMaterial applied to the avocado mesh after loading, replacing its default material. The vertex shader should pass UV, normal, and view direction to the fragment shader. The fragment shader must implement these uniforms controlled by dat.gui sliders: (1) u_fresnelPower (range 0.5-8.0, target: 3.0-4.5) controlling rim glow intensity, (2) u_chromaticSpread (range 0.0-0.15, target: 0.06-0.10) splitting RGB channels for prismatic effect, (3) u_noiseScale (range 1.0-20.0, target: 8.0-13.0) controlling procedural noise distortion on surface, (4) u_iridescenceStrength (range 0.0-1.0, target: 0.6-0.85) blending a view-angle-dependent rainbow hue shift, (5) u_carbonWeave (range 0.0-1.0, target: 0.3-0.55) overlaying a procedural carbon fibre crosshatch pattern using sine-based UV manipulation, and (6) u_timeSpeed (range 0.0-3.0, target: 1.2-2.0) controlling animation pulse rate via a time uniform. Pass elapsed time to the shader each frame. Display a status panel showing how many of the 6 parameters are within their target ranges. When all 6 are valid simultaneously, display a golden 'TRANSMUTATION COMPLETE' banner and make the avocado emit a pulsing glow. Use a dark background color (0x0a0a1a). Ensure smooth 60fps animation loop updating time uniform.
